capabilities: Generate SVG timeline backgrounds on Canvas files
Create parallel timeline columns with shared date lines
Skip disconnected time spans with gap sections
Edit columns, date ranges, and sections while keeping cards in place
Lock and crop the timeline background
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer; manual installation only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Metadata is stored on the SVG and in a .timeline-meta.json sidecar; timelines created with older plugin versions may not fully support later edits.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Canvas is excellent for spatial thinking, but it has no built-in time grid.
motivation: The author spent half the time stretching and tweaking existing timelines so cards lined up, and built a background that keeps everything in its final location from the start.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in time grid, so timeline cards drift and comparing parallel event streams across dates is hard to keep aligned.
summary: Generates vertical SVG timeline backgrounds for Obsidian Canvas so cards align to a shared date axis, with parallel columns and editable sections.
